resources.string: Four Warriors of Light arise to restore the crystals stolen by the Forces of Chaos...
The Palamecian Empire spreads darkness. Firion and his rebel friends fight for freedom...
Orphaned children chosen by the Crystals of Light must restore balance to the world...
Cecil the Dark Knight seeks redemption on Mt. Ordeals, battling the Four Elemental Archfiends to save the two moons...
Bartz and his companions journey across shattered worlds to seal away Exdeath and protect the Wind, Water, Fire, and Earth Crystals...
Terra, Locke, and the Returners fight against the Gestahlian Empire and the mad jester Kefka who threatens to shatter the balance of magic...
Cloud Strife and AVALANCHE fight Shinra Electric Power Company and the legendary SOLDIER Sephiroth to save the Planet\'s Mako energy...
Squall Leonhart and SeeD mercenaries travel across time to stop Sorceress Ultimecia from achieving Time Compression...
Zidane Tribal and Tantalus theater troupe kidnap Princess Garnet and uncover Kuja\'s plot to destroy the Crystal of Creation...
Tidus, Yuna, and guardians set out on a pilgrimage across Spira to defeat the terrifying entity known as Sin...
The boundary of dimensions shatters into infinity. Face the cosmic convergence of every boss across spacetime.
